standard-dialogue-before-the-feud.npc: Welcome, adventurer, to the town of Pollnivneach, the gateway to Menaphos and Al Kharid. My name is Ali and I'm the mayor of this town. I hope you enjoy your stay here.

standard-dialogue-before-the-feud.player: Thank you. That is one of the warmest welcomes I've ever had! People generally treat travelling adventurers with suspicion.

standard-dialogue-before-the-feud.npc: All are welcome here. Now more than ever I suppose.

standard-dialogue-before-the-feud.player: What do you mean by that?

standard-dialogue-before-the-feud.npc: There's trouble in town, and a lot of villagers have left as a result. Things are looking dire.

after-the-feud.npc: Thank you once again. Have you spoken to Ali Morrisane yet?

after-the-feud.player: Yes, I spoke to him already. He really had me going with his little 'tourism' trick!

after-the-feud.npc: Well, not to be immodest, but it was all my idea.
Our little town needed help, and I knew it'd take the greatest salesman in Gielinor to attract an adventurer strong enough to help us out.
In any case, I have my mayoral duties to attend to. I have lots of new citizens to register!
